# Create merged object 
```{r, include=FALSE}
create.seurat.obj <- T

if (create.seurat.obj) {
  seurat.obj.list <- list()
  
  visium.metadata.df <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM_Spatial/", "Inputs/", "general/", "visium_metadata.csv"))
  rownames(visium.metadata.df) <- paste0(visium.metadata.df$sample, "_", visium.metadata.df$spot_id, "_1")
  samples <- sort(unique(visium.metadata.df$sample))
  
  for (sample.id in samples) {
    print(sample.id)
    
    sample.dir <- paste0(data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM_Spatial/", "Inputs/", "general/", "GBM_data/", sample.id, "/", "outs/")
    infoTable <- data.frame(samples = paste0(sample.dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"),
               spotfiles = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "tissue_positions_list.csv"),
               imgs = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "tissue_hires_image.png"),
               json = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "scalefactors_json.json"))
    
    seurat.obj <- InputFromTable(infotable = infoTable, platform = "Visium")
    seurat.obj <- LoadImages(seurat.obj, time.resolve = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
  
    seurat.obj$sample.id <- sample.id
    
    # normalize data
    seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj, scale.factor = 100000)
    
    # add percent.mt
    seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-") 
    
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, oligo.gene.signatures)
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, oligo.jakel2019.signatures)
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, myelination.signatures)
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures.gsea)
    
    seurat.obj <- score.neftel(seurat.obj, signatures.dir="/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Shared_resources/Signatures/Neftel_GBM_cell_states/SingleCell_GBM/", assay.use = "RNA")

    
    seurat.obj.list[[sample.id]] <- seurat.obj
  }
  
  print("Merging")
  seurat.obj.merged <- MergeSTData(seurat.obj.list[[1]], seurat.obj.list[2:length(seurat.obj.list)], add.spot.ids = names(seurat.obj.list), merge.data = T)
  
  # add metadata
  seurat.obj.merged <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj.merged, visium.metadata.df)
  
  seurat.obj.merged$ivygap <- factor(seurat.obj.merged$ivygap, levels = c("PAN", "MVP", "CT", "LE"))
  
  seurat.obj.merged$region <- sapply(seurat.obj.merged$sample, function(x) 
    case_when(
      grepl("ZH8811Abulk", x) ~ "1A_bulk",
      grepl("ZH8811Bbulk", x) ~ "1B_bulk",
      grepl("ZH8812bulk", x) ~ "2_bulk",
      grepl("nec", x) ~ "nec",
      grepl("T1", x) ~ "T1",
      grepl("inf", x) ~ "inf",
      grepl("bulk", x) ~ "bulk",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )
  seurat.obj.merged$region <- factor(seurat.obj.merged$region, levels = c("nec", "T1", "inf", "bulk"))
  seurat.obj.merged$tumor <- sapply(seurat.obj.merged$sample, function(x) str_replace(x, "nec|T1|inf|bulk", ""))
  seurat.obj.merged$tumor <- sapply(seurat.obj.merged$tumor, function(x) ifelse(x %in% c("ZH8811Abulk", "ZH8811Bbulk", "ZH8812bulk"), "ZH881", x))
  seurat.obj.merged$barcode <- colnames(seurat.obj.merged)
  
  
  #seurat.obj.merged$oligo.like.up <- seurat.obj.merged$oligo.like # TODO need to rename in the future
  seurat.obj.merged$mp <- sapply(seurat.obj.merged$mp, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "Low.quality", x))
  
  print(dim(seurat.obj.merged))
  saveRDS(seurat.obj.merged, paste0(processed.data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_seurat.obj.merged.RDS"))
}
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
oligo.df <- seurat.obj.merged@meta.data %>% filter(mp == "Oligo")


## Signature by region
oligo.w.region.df <- oligo.df %>% filter(!is.na(region))
#my.comparisons <- list(c("nec", "T1"), c("nec", "inf"), c("T1", "inf")) # comparisons should be in order
stat.test <- oligo.w.region.df %>% 
  group_by(tumor) %>%
  wilcox_test(reactive.oligo.general ~ region, alternative = "greater") %>% 
  adjust_pvalue(method = "none") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "region") 
stat.test$pval.label <- apply(stat.test, 1, function(row) 
  case_when(
    row[["p.adj.signif"]] != "ns" ~ row[["p.adj.signif"]],
    as.numeric(row[["p.adj"]]) < 0.1 ~ as.character(row[["p.adj"]]),
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
)
stat.test <- stat.test %>% filter(!is.na(pval.label))

p <- ggplot(oligo.w.region.df, aes(region, reactive.oligo.general)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, position = position_jitter()) + 
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~tumor) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "pval.label")
```

# Fraction of cell types in neighborhood - sample level
```{r, include=FALSE}

all.samples.neighborhood.df <- data.frame()
for (sample.id.use in samples) {
  print(sample.id.use)
  
  # subsetting doesn't work for some reason so I have to recreate each sample object
  sample.dir <- paste0(data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM_Spatial/", "Inputs/", "general/", "GBM_data/", sample.id.use, "/", "outs/")
  infoTable <- data.frame(samples = paste0(sample.dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"),
             spotfiles = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "tissue_positions_list.csv"),
             imgs = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "tissue_hires_image.png"),
             json = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "scalefactors_json.json"))
  
  seurat.obj <- InputFromTable(infotable = infoTable, platform = "Visium")
  seurat.obj <- LoadImages(seurat.obj, time.resolve = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
  
  # add metadata for sample
  visium.metadata.df.sample <- visium.metadata.df %>% filter(sample == sample.id.use)
  rownames(visium.metadata.df.sample) <- paste0(visium.metadata.df.sample$spot_id, "_1")
  
  seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, visium.metadata.df.sample)
  seurat.obj$mp <- seurat.obj$mp %>% sapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "Low quality", x))
  
  if (!("Oligo" %in% unique(seurat.obj$mp))) {
    print("No oligos")
    next
  }
  
  seurat.obj <- SetIdent(seurat.obj, value = "mp")
  
  # neighbors (1-hop)
  seurat.obj <- RegionNeighbours(seurat.obj, id = "Oligo", keep.within.id = T, verbose = T)
  seurat.obj$nbs_Oligo <- sapply(seurat.obj$nbs_Oligo, function(x) case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "Other",
    x == "nbs_Oligo" ~ "nbs_Oligo",
    TRUE ~ "Other")
  )
  #table(seurat.obj$nbs_Oligo)
  
  # neighbors of neighbors (2-hop)
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- "nbs_Oligo"
  seurat.obj <- RegionNeighbours(seurat.obj, id = "nbs_Oligo", keep.within.id = T, verbose = T)
  seurat.obj$nbs_nbs_Oligo <- sapply(seurat.obj$nbs_nbs_Oligo, function(x) case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "Other",
    x == "nbs_nbs_Oligo" ~ "nbs_nbs_Oligo",
    TRUE ~ "Other")
  )
  #table(seurat.obj$nbs_nbs_Oligo)
  
  #  3-hop
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- "nbs_nbs_Oligo"
  seurat.obj <- RegionNeighbours(seurat.obj, id = "nbs_nbs_Oligo", keep.within.id = T, verbose = T)
  seurat.obj$nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo <- sapply(seurat.obj$nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo, function(x) case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "Other",
    x == "nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo" ~ "nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo",
    TRUE ~ "Other")
  )
  #table(seurat.obj$nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo)
  
  seurat.obj$neighbor.annotation <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
    row[["mp"]] == "Oligo" ~ "Oligo",
    row[["nbs_Oligo"]] == "nbs_Oligo" ~ "nbs_Oligo",
    row[["nbs_nbs_Oligo"]] == "nbs_nbs_Oligo" ~ "nbs_nbs_Oligo",
    row[["nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo"]] == "nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo" ~ "nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

  # plot oligos and neighbors
  #FeatureOverlay(seurat.obj, features = "neighbor.annotation", sampleids = 1, cols = c("lightgrey", "blue", "green", "yellow", "red"), pt.size = 2)
  
  #oligos <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("Oligo")) 
  
  if (n.hop == 1) {
    oligo.nbs <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("nbs_Oligo")) 
  } else if (n.hop == 2) {
    oligo.nbs <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("nbs_Oligo", "nbs_nbs_Oligo"))
  } else if (n.hop == 3) {
    oligo.nbs <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("nbs_Oligo", "nbs_nbs_Oligo", "nbs_nbs_nbs_Oligo"))
  }
  
  neighbors.df <- data.frame(table(oligo.nbs$mp))
  colnames(neighbors.df) <- c("celltype", "nbs_freq")
  neighbors.df <- neighbors.df %>% filter(celltype != "Low quality") # remove low quality
  
  # add non-existant cell types in neighborhood with value 0
  for (x in setdiff(all.cell.types, neighbors.df$celltype)) {
    neighbors.df <- rbind(neighbors.df, data.frame(celltype = x, nbs_freq = 0))
  }
  num.neighbors <- sum(neighbors.df$nbs_freq)
  neighbors.df$fraction.nbs <- round(neighbors.df$nbs_freq / sum(neighbors.df$nbs_freq), 3)
  neighbors.df$nbs_freq = NULL
  neighbors.df <- neighbors.df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = celltype, values_from = fraction.nbs)
  neighbors.df$sample.id <- sample.id.use
  neighbors.df$num.neighbors <- num.neighbors
  
  all.samples.neighborhood.df <- rbind(all.samples.neighborhood.df, neighbors.df)
}

write.table(all.samples.neighborhood.df, paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "spatial_analysis/", "n.hop=", n.hop, "_all.samples.neighborhood.df.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

# Fraction of cell types in neighborhood - cell level
```{r, include=FALSE}
malignant.mps <- c("AC", "Prolif.Metab", "OPC", "MES.Hyp", "MES.Ast", "MES", "Chromatin.Reg", "NPC")
all.cell.types <- c(setdiff(all.cell.types, malignant.mps), "FGFpos GBM", "FGFneg GBM")


compute.cell.level.neighborhood <- T

if (compute.cell.level.neighborhood) {
  
  for (sample.id in samples) {
    print(sample.id)
    
    sample.dir <- paste0(data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM_Spatial/", "Inputs/", "general/", "GBM_data/", sample.id, "/", "outs/")
    infoTable <- data.frame(samples = paste0(sample.dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"), 
               spotfiles = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "tissue_positions_list.csv"),
               imgs = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "tissue_hires_image.png"),
               json = paste0(sample.dir, "spatial/", "scalefactors_json.json"))
  
    seurat.obj <- InputFromTable(infotable = infoTable, platform =  "Visium")
    seurat.obj <- LoadImages(seurat.obj, time.resolve = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
    
    visium.metadata.df.sample <- visium.metadata.df %>% filter(sample == sample.id)
    rownames(visium.metadata.df.sample) <- paste0(visium.metadata.df.sample$spot_id, "_1")
    
    seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, visium.metadata.df.sample)
    
    seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
    data <- FetchData(seurat.obj, vars = c("FGF1", "FGF2"))
    seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, data)
    
    unique(seurat.obj$mp)
    seurat.obj@meta.data <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% mutate(mp = ifelse(mp %in% malignant.mps, ifelse(FGF1 + FGF2 > 0, "FGFpos GBM", "FGFneg GBM"), mp))
    
    if (!("Oligo" %in% unique(seurat.obj$mp))) {
      print("No oligos")
      next
    }
    
    seurat.obj$mp <- seurat.obj$mp %>% sapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "Low quality", x))
    seurat.obj$barcode <- colnames(seurat.obj)
    Idents(seurat.obj) <- "barcode"
    
    oligo.barcodes <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(mp == "Oligo") %>% pull(barcode)
    #oligo.barcodes <- sample(oligo.barcodes, min(length(oligo.barcodes), 50)) # sample to test
    
    seurat.obj.original <- seurat.obj
    neighbors.df <- data.frame()
  
    for (barcode in oligo.barcodes) {
      
      seurat.obj <- seurat.obj.original
      
      # find direct neighbors of oligo spot (nhop = 1)
      seurat.obj <- RegionNeighbours(seurat.obj, id = barcode, keep.within.id = T, verbose = F)
      #table(seurat.obj@meta.data[[paste0("nbs_", barcode)]])
      seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs"]] <- sapply(seurat.obj@meta.data[[paste0("nbs_", barcode)]], function(x) case_when(
        is.na(x) ~ "other",
        x == paste0("nbs_", barcode) ~ "nbs",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ))
      #table(seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs"]])
      
      #FeatureOverlay(seurat.obj, features = paste0("nbs_", barcode), sampleids = 1, pt.size = 2)
      
      # neighbors of neighbors (nhop = 2)
      Idents(seurat.obj) <- "nbs"
      seurat.obj <- RegionNeighbours(seurat.obj, id = "nbs", keep.within.id = T, verbose = F)
      seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs"]] <- sapply(seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs"]], function(x) case_when(
        is.na(x) ~ "other",
        x == "nbs_nbs" ~ "nbs_nbs",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ))
      #table(seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs"]])
      
      # nhop = 3
      Idents(seurat.obj) <- "nbs_nbs"
      seurat.obj <- RegionNeighbours(seurat.obj, id = "nbs_nbs", keep.within.id = T, verbose = F)
      #table(seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs_nbs"]])
      seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs_nbs"]] <- sapply(seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs_nbs"]], function(x) case_when(
        is.na(x) ~ "other",
        x == "nbs_nbs_nbs" ~ "nbs_nbs_nbs",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ))
      #table(seurat.obj@meta.data[["nbs_nbs_nbs"]])
      
      
      seurat.obj$neighbor.annotation <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
        row[["barcode"]] == barcode ~ "barcode",
        row[["nbs"]] == "nbs" ~ "nbs",
        row[["nbs_nbs"]] == "nbs_nbs" ~ "nbs_nbs",
        row[["nbs_nbs_nbs"]] == "nbs_nbs_nbs" ~ "nbs_nbs_nbs",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ))
      
      # run below to QC specific oligo spot
      #FeatureOverlay(seurat.obj, features = "neighbor.annotation", sampleids = 1, cols = c("lightgrey", "blue", "green", "yellow", "red"), pt.size = 2)
      
      if (n.hop == 1) {
        oligo.barcode.nbs <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("nbs")) 
      } else if (n.hop == 2) {
        oligo.barcode.nbs <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("nbs", "nbs_nbs")) 
      } else if (n.hop == 3) {
        oligo.barcode.nbs <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(neighbor.annotation %in% c("nbs", "nbs_nbs", "nbs_nbs_nbs")) 
      }
      
      barcode.nbs.df <- data.frame(table(oligo.barcode.nbs$mp))
      
      if (nrow(barcode.nbs.df) == 0) {
        print("No neighbors, next")
        next
      }
      
      # filter low quality
      barcode.nbs.df <- barcode.nbs.df %>% filter(Var1 != "Low quality")
  
      if (nrow(barcode.nbs.df) == 0) {
        print("No high-quality neighbors, next")
        next
      }
      
      num.neighbors <- sum(barcode.nbs.df$Freq)
      
      for (x in setdiff(all.cell.types, barcode.nbs.df$Var1)) {
        barcode.nbs.df <- rbind(barcode.nbs.df, data.frame(Var1 = x, Freq = 0))
      }
      
      barcode.nbs.df$fraction <- round(barcode.nbs.df$Freq / num.neighbors, 3)
      
      barcode.nbs.df$barcode <- barcode
      barcode.nbs.wider.df <- barcode.nbs.df %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = barcode, names_from = Var1, values_from = fraction)
      barcode.nbs.wider.df$n.neighbors <- num.neighbors
      
      neighbors.df <- rbind(neighbors.df, barcode.nbs.wider.df)
    }
    
    neighbors.df <- data.frame(neighbors.df)
    neighbors.df$sample.id <- sample.id
    
    write.table(neighbors.df, paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", sample.id, "_neighborhood.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F)
  }
  
  
  # add neighbor info to seurat object
  seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(processed.data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_seurat.obj.merged.RDS"))
  
  all.cell.types <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$mp))
  samples <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$sample.id))
  print(samples)
  
  seurat.obj.list <- list()
  
  for (sample.id.use in samples) {
    print(sample.id.use)
    
    seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj.merged, subset = sample == sample.id.use)
   
    if ("Oligo" %ni% unique(seurat.obj$mp)) {
      print("No oligodendrocytes")
      next
    }
    
    neighborhood.df <- read.csv(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", sample.id.use, "_neighborhood.tsv"), sep = "\t")
    rownames(neighborhood.df) <- paste0(sample.id.use, "_", neighborhood.df$barcode)
    seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, neighborhood.df)
    
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = mp == "Oligo")
    
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, gene.signatures)
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, oligo.gene.signatures)
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, oligo.jakel2019.signatures)
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, myelination.signatures)
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, gene.signatures.gsea)
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, fgfr.gene.signatures)
    
    
    seurat.obj.list[[sample.id.use]] <- seurat.obj.subset
  }
  
  
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- merge(seurat.obj.list[[1]], seurat.obj.list[2:length(seurat.obj.list)])
  saveRDS(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, paste0(processed.data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_oligodendrocytes.merged.w.neighborhood.metadata_n.hop=", n.hop, ".RDS"))
  dim(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood)
}
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

n.hop <- 3
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- readRDS(paste0(processed.data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_oligodendrocytes.merged.w.neighborhood.metadata_n.hop=", n.hop, ".RDS"))
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$filter <- is.na(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$Mac)
table(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$filter)

dim(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood)

if (n.hop == 1) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 3)
} else if (n.hop == 2) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 9)
} else if (n.hop == 3) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 10)
}

dim(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood)
```

```{r}
        next
      }
      seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = sample.id == s.id & hypoxia.level == hyp.level)
      p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset@meta.data, aes(neighborhood.annotation, .data[[y]], color = hypoxia.level)) + 
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
        theme_bw() +
        stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.y.npc = "bottom") +
        stat_compare_means(ref.group = "None", method.args = list(alternative = "greater"), label = "p.format") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
        xlab("Neighborhood") +
        ylab(y) + 
        ggtitle(s.id, subtitle = paste0("Hypoxia level = ", hyp.level)) +
        scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Low", "High"), values = c("#2E86AB", "#C0392B")) +
        ylim(c(y.min, y.max))
      plot.list[[paste(s.id, hyp.level)]] <- p
    }
  }
  p <- plot_grid(plotlist = plot.list)
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", "neighborhood_vs_", y, "_by_hypoxia.level.pdf"), width = 30, height = 30)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  # not split by hypoxia level
  plot.list <- c()
  for (s.id in sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$sample.id))) {
    
    temp <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood@meta.data %>% filter(sample.id == s.id)
    if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
      next
    }
    seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = sample.id == s.id)
    p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset@meta.data, aes(neighborhood.annotation, .data[[y]])) + 
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.5, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), fill = "#B76EB8", shape = 21) +
      theme_bw() +
      stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.y.npc = "bottom") +
      stat_compare_means(ref.group = "None", method.args = list(alternative = "greater"), label = "p.format") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
      xlab("Neighborhood") +
      ylab(y) + 
      ggtitle(s.id) +
      ylim(c(y.min, y.max))
    plot.list[[paste(s.id, hyp.level)]] <- p
  }
  p <- plot_grid(plotlist = plot.list)
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", "neighborhood_vs_", y, ".pdf"), width = 30, height = 30)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", "models/"))


data <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood@meta.data
data <- data %>% dplyr::select(reactive.oligo.general, inflammatory.signature, hypoxia.signature, all_of(setdiff(all.cell.types, "Low.quality")))
data <- data[complete.cases(data), ] # remove rows with NAs
data <- data[, colSums(data != 0) > 0] # remove columns with all zero

data <- data %>%
  dplyr::rename(`Reactive oligodendrocyte signature` = reactive.oligo.general,
         `Hypoxia signature` = hypoxia.signature,
         `Inflammatory signature` = inflammatory.signature)

# correlation plot
res <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(data), type = "pearson")
cor.table <- res$r
p.mat     <- res$P
p.mat[is.na(p.mat)] <- 1
  
col_range <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200)
pdf(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", "corrplots/", "all.samples.spot.level_corrplot.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
corrplot(
  cor.table,
  order = "hclust",
  hclust.method = "average",
  type = "upper",
  method = "color",
  col = col_range,
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  p.mat = p.mat,
  sig.level = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05),
  insig = "label_sig",
  pch.col = "black",
  pch.cex = 1.2
)
text(x = 21, y = 10, labels = "Pearson's correlation", 
 srt = 270, xpd = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
dev.off()
```

# Ligand-receptor
```{r}
n.hop <- 1
seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(processed.data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_seurat.obj.merged.RDS"))
seurat.obj.merged.oligo <- readRDS(paste0(processed.data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_oligodendrocytes.merged.w.neighborhood.metadata_n.hop=", n.hop, ".RDS"))


if (n.hop == 1) {
  seurat.obj.merged.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.oligo, subset = n.neighbors >= 3)
} else if (n.hop == 2) {
  seurat.obj.merged.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.oligo, subset = n.neighbors >= 9)
}

all.cell.types <- sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged$mp))



# add ligand receptor data
features.data <- FetchData(seurat.obj.merged, vars = c("FGFR1", "FGFR2", "FGF2", "CD47", "SIRPA", "CD44"))
seurat.obj.merged <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj.merged, features.data)
seurat.obj.merged.oligo <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj.merged.oligo, features.data)


seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.total <- seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES + seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.Ast  + seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.Hyp
mes.threshold <- 0
seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.level <- sapply(seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.total, function(x) ifelse(x <= mes.threshold, "Low", "High"))
seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.level <- factor(seurat.obj.merged.oligo$MES.level, levels = c("Low", "High"))

# TODO x = FGF2 expressing MES
# sample level FGF2 mes vs FGFR2 in oligodendrocytes

# ligand receptor expression
p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.oligo@meta.data, aes(MES.level, FGFR2)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, position=position_jitter()) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~sample.id) +
  stat_compare_means() +
  ylab("FGFR2 in oligodendrocytes")
pdf(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", "interactions/", "FGFR2_expression_by_mes_threshold=", mes.threshold, ".pdf"), width = 14, height = 14)
print(p)

pdf(paste0(results.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "neighborhood_analysis/", n.hop, "_hop/", "interactions/", "FGFR2_expression_by_mes_fraction.pdf"), width = 14, height = 14)
print(p)

# to do split by sample
```

```{r}
codex.cells <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, "Greenwald_2024_GBM_Spatial/", "Inputs/", "Codex/", "cells_table.RDS"))
```
